comment: Source is not published. Read against the README at tag v2.6.13, which carries a control-by-control guide to this module. The +1.7V trigger minimum the README gives is exact, and the release is +0.2V, which the README does not mention. The selected channel's input channel count gates the call to loadKitPiece. QuadPercsWidget::appendContextMenu adds only the Model submenu and the greyed licence label, so there is no menu line.
